sources.title: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B is a mixture-of-experts language model developed by ornith-ai that activates approximately 3 billion parameters per token despite containing 35 billion total parameters. The model builds on a foundation of Qwen 3.5 and Gemma 4 through continued pretraining, mid-training, and post-training with reinforcement learning.

sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B is a 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts reasoning model from Ornith AI that activates roughly 3B parameters per token. Optimized for agentic coding, complex reasoning, and tool-driven workflows, its FP8 weights reduce memory requirements for more efficient deployment.
